Preview of the first release. Everything here is one batch of initial research, and every score is provisional until 2026-09-29. Organizations and people named here, and anyone else, can submit corrections or evidence until then; what arrives becomes the launch round of the paper. No tag is citable until the gates pass. How to submit. Update, 15 September: primary-source re-derivation strengthened the record; no scores changed.

Sources

247 sources cited by signals: 232 confirmed, 2 imported, 10 unaudited, 3 unverifiable. Tier 1 is a filing or a funder's own index; tier 2 a third-party ledger; tier 3 the organization's own statement; tier 4 press, split into primary (a named editorial outlet) and aggregator (newsletters, wikis, wires, law-firm alerts). Under the standard evidence policy only confirmed sources move a value; imported and unverifiable ones stay visible as leads.
